nodes.text: China’s diet of horrifying, disease-ridden animals is exactly why the world faces constant pandemics. Their unthinkable food choices are fueling global health crises, and yet they keep going. How many more outbreaks will it take for change to happen? @PhaedraXTeddy 3/3
